title: AML/KYC Analyst
summary: AML/KYC analysts check that a bank or fintech knows who its customers are and spot money laundering, by reviewing customer documents, screening names against sanctions lists and investigating unusual transactions. They sit in the financial crime compliance or operations team and pass suspicious cases on for reporting to FIU-IND, India's financial intelligence unit.
dailyDuties: Review KYC documents and ownership details for new and existing customers
Complete enhanced due diligence on high-risk customers
Screen names for sanctions, PEP and adverse media hits
Investigate transaction monitoring alerts and write case notes
Escalate suspicious cases and draft STRs
Track case ageing and quality review findings

skills.expectation: Complete CDD and EDD reviews for onboarding and periodic KYC
Investigate transaction monitoring alerts and close or escalate them
Screen customers for sanctions, PEP and adverse media hits
Draft suspicious transaction reports for FIU-IND
Apply PMLA, the RBI KYC Master Direction and FATF guidance
Track cases and alert volumes in Excel
Write clear case narratives and escalation notes
Know banking, payments or fintech products
Pull transaction data with SQL for investigations
Use pivot tables and lookups on transaction extracts
